## Background

Runs the head-to-head evaluation of every policy from
[C1](../C1-groot-finetuning/README.qmd) and
[C2](../C2-hf-vla-baselines/README.qmd) on the real OARbot, following
the protocol frozen in A2: per-task success rate, generalization to
unseen variations, and data-efficiency curves. Each evaluation session
is an experiment under this epic owning its trial logs and rollout
videos; the failure analysis feeds Future Work.
